principles: One authoritative writer per semantic fact.
Notion draft content is not runtime truth until it is compiled, validated, reviewed, and published to Git.
VS Code is the default daily learning and problem-solving surface.
Git contains deterministic machine contracts, code, tests, CI, and published curriculum snapshots.
Notion contains curriculum authoring, long-form teaching content, and durable learning records.
ChatGPT may coach, explain, diagnose, and propose evidence; it does not independently award mastery.
Generated dashboards, memory estimates, and next-review dates are derived state, not independent truth.
Review Due is a scheduling signal, not homework debt.
Problem count may grow without making daily review workload grow linearly.
New-learning capacity must remain protected even when review candidates accumulate.

skill_identity.policy: Skill UID is stable. Draft edits in Notion affect runtime only after publish.

skill_prerequisites.policy: Prerequisite graph must pass cycle and reference validation before publish.

problem_intrinsic_metadata.policy: Problem identity, source/judge URL, calibrated D1-D5 difficulty, and intrinsic relations are published from validated authoring data.

problem_solution_metadata.policy: Solution path, language, complexity, tests, and code stay Git-native.

problem_placement.policy: Role and lesson order belong to a placement/activity, not permanently to the problem itself.

attempt_facts.policy: VS Code captures facts once; durable writeback is idempotent. Unknown facts remain unknown.

evidence_events.policy: One evidence event evaluates one Skill x Track. Multiple events may originate from one attempt only when separately observable.

mastery.policy: RM/IM/RR/IR are derived from valid evidence and gate rules; no manual promotion without supporting evidence.

memory_state.policy: Stability, retrievability, and next-review estimates are rebuildable from evidence plus scheduler version; they are not canonical learning records.

daily_plan.policy: Daily selection obeys capacity limits and may defer candidates without creating debt.
